stats.notes: Confirmed one bug with a minimal reproduction: a movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player. From a fresh game with seed 1, pause+right moved the player from (1,1) to (2,1) with events [pause, move], while the game ended paused. The design says that when pause takes effect, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens. Run 2 (pause+left) showed a bump, which is the same root cause, so it is not reported separately. I stopped here because the remaining budget is small. Untested areas: toasts, restart, dash edge cases, hearts and spikes, enemy contact, and swap collisions.
